news.title: 2nd Test, Hagley Oval: India won the toss and bowled on a green pitch; Gurnoor Brar debuts in place of Prasidh Krishna, NZ unchanged
news.note: Series decider (0-0). The Day 1 replay needs a Cricinfo + Cricbuzz capture at stumps. India XI: Jaiswal, Rahul, Padikkal, Gill (c), Pant, Jurel, Washington, Kamboj, Akash Deep, Bumrah, Brar

news.title: Day 1: Latham and Conway put on 77; Brar's first Test wicket (Conway lbw for 31) came off the last ball before lunch; NZ 77/1 at lunch, 81/1 soon after
news.note: Rahul dropped Latham at second slip off Akash Deep in his 30s. The hook is the bowl-first gamble on a green top. Stumps score not yet confirmed at the time of writing

news.title: Nation Press: Brar's debut strike leaves NZ 77/1 at lunch
news.note: Second source for the lunch score

news.title: AP: Bumrah dismissed Latham in the first over of both innings in Wellington; NZ 3rd and India 4th in the WTC
news.note: Good Bumrah vs Latham hook. This time Latham survived the new ball

news.title: Mumbai Indians announce their IPL 2027 captain today (27 Nov) at 5:45 pm IST; Rohit Sharma is widely reported to return
